Name: E2E — cart is cleared after placing an orders
Description: Verifies that after a successful POST /orders, the cart becomes empty.

Name: E2E — orders keeps a snapshot of the product data
Description:
Places an orders, then updates the product price and name.
Verifies the orders keeps the original values — it's a snapshot, not a live reference to the product.

Name: E2E — cancel an orders and verify it stays cancelled
Description: Places an orders, cancels it via PUT /orders/{id}/cancel, and verifies the status is 'cancelled' via both response and GET /orders/{id}.

Name: E2E — cancelling an already cancelled orders returns 400
Description: Cancels an orders, then attempts to cancel it again and expects 400.

Name: E2E — cannot add more than available stock to the cart
Description: Verifies that adding a quantity greater than product stock fails with 400.

Name: E2E — placing an orders with an empty cart returns 400
Description: Verifies that POST /orders fails with 400 when the cart is empty.

Name: E2E — create product, add to cart, place orders
Description:
Full checkout flow across three services:
1. Create a product (POST /products)
2. Add it to the cart (POST /cart/items)
3. Place an orders (POST /orders)
4. Verify the orders is created with the correct items and total

Name: E2E — cancelling an orders does not return items to the cart
Description: Places an orders, cancels it, and verifies the cart remains empty.

Name: E2E — orders with multiple different products
Description: Adds two different products to the cart, places an orders, and verifies both items are included with the correct totals.
